Right now you keep only about €12.17 a month (over the last 6 months), so that leaves a gap of about €280. The winter months matter most. Last October to February, €4,719 more went out than came in, and groceries alone came to €4,987. Keeping this winter's grocery spending in check is where the Japan money is most likely to come from.

I assumed one person, two weeks and a September trip. Want me to save this as your goal?
